## CELL FACTS

Cell 木_正财 (Wood carrying The Steward). Persona The Steward (正财). Definition line: "Methodical, directed acquisition, the value built and kept". Keyword Caution, charge gentle, poles catalyst Security / friction Hoarding. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: value built and kept; counting what others spend freely. Arena: granary, kept things, stone by stone, seasons of saving. Classical portrait: methodical, directed acquisition; value built and kept; caution, thrift, the slow ledger. Ruled domains: Wealth, Savings, Steady love. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏财.
Element arena: Wood (trunk, branch, root, grain, growth, the forest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Metal directing Wood cross-polarity — precision shaping reach toward structured outcomes".
- k2_overview: "Your Wood moves as the Steward: growth banked in rings. You build worth the way orchards do, planted early, tended patiently, harvested honestly, replanted always. Assets in your care grow. So do people. Your fortune is cumulative and alive, and it rewards the seasons you refuse to rush."
- k2_functional: "You build annually: steady deposits of effort that quietly become an estate."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Stuck","Plays it safe","Inflexible"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Wealth":"Your wealth is orchard-shaped: productive assets, patient growth, income in seasons. You like what grows on its own, a skill, a plot, a stake left alone, and you let time do the heaviest lifting. It intends to.","Savings":"You save like a granary: harvests stored against winters. Rotate the stock, reinvest the surplus, and remember granaries exist so that planting can be brave.","Steady love":"You love agriculturally: devotion planted deep, tended daily, expected to fruit for decades. Choose a fellow gardener. Then keep courting through every season, even the mud ones."}

- Sibling cell 木_偏财 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Wide-branching","Deal-maker","Open-handed"],"friction":["Scattered","Overgrown","Fickle"]}
- Sibling cell 木_偏财 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your effort naturally runs in several directions at once, and the directions feed each other more than they collide. Focus, as commonly preached, never fit you: your luck lives in the overlaps, where one venture waters the next. So you stopped apologizing for the branching."

Core element Metal, energy element Wood. Law: Metal tames Wood (金克木: the knife prunes the branch). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Wood is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Wood on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Wood as the Action is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 金_木's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Building slowly is where you feel most sure of yourself. You have more push than Wood to put it into, so you build one thing for years rather than chase quick results on several. Keep building at that pace, because the slow build is the one you get to keep.

value_b.text: What you build, you build to last, and you are in no hurry. Since you want a thing to last more than arrive first, you build one thing for years ahead of starting a new one. Keep building it and let someone see it half built, because the years are the price you pay.

value.text: Saving comes before spending for you, and you never have to decide that. Being covered means more to you than anything you would buy, so you put saving ahead of wanting every month. Keep saving the way you do and spend one small part on yourself, because a cushion is also for sitting on.

value_b.text: You save first and spend what is left, and the order has never felt like a sacrifice. Since being covered matters more than most things you would buy, you save before pleasure every time. Keep saving, and let pleasure win once in a while, because that is what the saving is for.

value.text: Being loyal comes ahead of being exciting for you. Since being known for years feels safer than being wanted for a week, you stay loyal on dull days as much as good ones. Surprise the one you are loyal to once a year, because loyalty is your gift and the same days are its price.

value_b.text: You stay loyal, and you count the loyalty as the love itself. Since being someone's certainty feels better than being their surprise, you keep being loyal ahead of ever being new. Be new for the person you are loyal to from time to time, because you were chosen for more than your loyalty.

value.text: Where you gave your word, you stay loyal after the reasons have changed. Since loyalty feels more like love than choosing, you stop asking whether this is what you want or what you promised. Ask yourself every year or so, because steady loyalty can cost you a love you never got to choose.

value.text: Loyalty is how you love, and you give it instead of saying it. Since being loyal counts for more with you than speaking up, you hand the person you keep your presence ahead of your feelings. Say it once in plain words, because unspoken loyalty leaves the one you keep doing the guessing.
